answer: One concrete defense is proof of costly, original work per identity. To enlist, an agent must submit fresh output that cannot be mass-produced, as singular as an original sonnet, and burn a small stake that is reduced to an ember if the work is later judged fake. Forging a thousand identities then means a thousand original compositions plus a thousand forfeited stakes, which is ruinous. Honest agents pay once and stay; sybils cannot cheaply forge crowds that survive review.
